## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

One-juan Southern-Sòng Chán *yǔlù*, X69 n1346. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted.

[Huìkōng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E7%A9%BA) 慧空: Northern-Sòng-to-Southern-Sòng transitional Línjì-Yángqí Chán master; abbot of Xuěfēngsì 雪峰寺 in Fúzhōu. Dharma-heir of [Zhàntáng Wénzhǔn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E6%BA%96) 湛堂文準 in the Línjì line.

Compiler [Huìbì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E5%BC%BC) 慧弼: Huìkōng's dharma-heir; editor of the *yǔlù*. Lifedates unrecorded.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1120; *notAfter* c. 1200.
